level_rationale: L4 (Registry): all 14 digest vectors, all 31 registry skill digests, all 16 security corpus cases and all 31 registry skill rule sets identical to the Python implementation; plus lockfile verification agreeing on a deliberately tampered install, including the exit-code taxonomy. Verified by agtmls-spec/conformance/run.py, which compares the two implementations to each other rather than only to expected values.

not_implemented.install: agtmls-core verifies an install but does not create one. Installation remains the Python implementation's responsibility; the lockfile is the interop boundary.
